Team / Susan — I reviewed Acme's draft (see attached PDF markup). High-level notes: 

1) Privilege carveout for regulatory audits — we generally don't accept broad carveouts that undermine our right to rely on legal privilege. We can offer a narrow language that permits production of non-privileged operational records for regulatory bodies, plus a mutual notification process and attempt to seek protective treatment. Proposed compromise (we'll add exact wording to the markup): limit carveout to "statutory regulatory inquiries" and require prior notice + Redwood right to seek protective order.

2) Indemnity and cap — Acme requests uncapped indemnity for third-party claims tied to product liability. We can accept a negotiated increase to the cap for explicitly scoped pilot orders up to 2x fees for the pilot period; for enterprise volumes we'd need a defined liability cap tied to insurance limits.

3) Payment SLA — 60 days is outside our standard 30-day net terms. For pilot orders we can accept net 45 with a one-time exception; finance needs to sign off.

Next steps: I'll produce a tracked PDF (MSA_redline_markup.pdf) with the proposed alternate language and call out the items that need commercial signoff (payment terms, indemnity). Karthik — can you confirm whether the PO prefix "ACM-" will break any downstream systems? Monica — please confirm required portal fields and whether we support line-level tax in Ariba.

Markus Klein
General Counsel (Contracting Lead)
Redwood Inference
(attachment: MSA_redline_markup.pdf - pdf)
